caveats: Vertex functions are stated in the leg order of the Feynman rules eq:V-src-gauge / eq:V-src-matter as Feynman rule / i, i.e. the V_Y convention of sec:dictionary (coefficient of theta_1...theta_n). The one-loop/tree ratios used in the report are independent of this choice. Observation on 02_method.typ (after eq:m-glue-wFF): with standard left derivatives Gamma_{Phi1 Phi2} = delta_{Phi1}(delta_{Phi2} Gamma), Gamma^(0)_{omega rho} = -i q^mu agrees, but Gamma^(0)_{Rbar omega Psi} = -i T P_c and Gamma^(0)_{omega Psibar R} = -i P_cbar T (not +i); the quoted +i values follow the V_Y convention instead. The quoted tree values thus mix two ordering conventions; this does not affect this class (ratios) but matters for the signs in the gluing formula eq:m-glue-wFF.
Vertex functions in the V_Y convention of 03b (coefficient of theta_1..theta_n, = Feynman rule / i, legs in the order written); only one-loop/tree ratios enter.

The ghost-sector poles are d-dimensional covariant; delta S is stated with d-dimensional indices and the 4d basis names Q_(rho partial), Q_rho[fg] denote their covariant continuations. If the 03b basis is read strictly 4-dimensional, the remainders integral rhohat.partialhat omega and integral fg rhohat.Ahat omega are evanescent monomials not listed in eq:evanescent.
